findings.consequence: An operational checker/runbook could incorrectly omit queue worker/delivery facts or misstate how wake-ups reach the durable state machine.
findings.location: email-operations-b5-design-20261015.md paragraph3: not ordinary Laravel Mail/queue jobs
findings.problem: The queue-job exclusion contradicts actual retained identity wake-up behavior. IdentityRequests dispatches DeliverProductionIdentityNotice, which implements ShouldQueue, uses Queueable, tries=1 and afterCommit, with noticeId only. Its handle invokes WorkIdentityNotice.
findings.smallest_correction: Say identity SMTP is not ordinary Laravel Mail; one-attempt Laravel queue wake-ups carry noticeId only and invoke WorkIdentityNotice, while customers:process-identity-notices separately performs bounded retained recovery. Keep Laravel worker/retry timing facts distinct from the durable attempt policy.

implementation_conditions: Define explicit closed versioned template/operator schema before claiming complete configuration-facts validation; null/unset/template placeholders must remain blocked in operator scope, and completeness remains unverified operator declarations. Never return input values or resolved file paths.

Bind actual recovery facts: command default50/allowed1..100,120second durable lease,600second identity TTL,maximum3 durable attempts,30*attempt-number delay only after definitely_not_submitted; accepted/unknown/blocked terminal. Fix ambiguous bounded50/default100max phrasing.

Keep generic Laravel worker timeout/retry_after ordering distinct from retained attempt lease/SMTP socket timeout and the ShouldQueue wake-up. SMTP socket timeout5 is per socket I/O, not whole submission or wall-time guarantee.

Match actual SMTP mode/security/provenance/origin admission or identify a stricter planned installation policy as such; source accepts ports1..65535 with implicit_tls/starttls and does not prove conventional-port-only or sender/public-origin same-domain rules. No credentials, derived capability authentication or provider attestation from JSON facts.

Keep production suppression254 provider descriptor distinct (adapter/version/scope/reviewReference), unbound/default-off; unknown reconciliation inspect-only and at-most-one suppress attempt, never generic queue resend or confirmed delivery.

Bound protected file reading from one admitted opened descriptor; reject symlink/hardlink/overexposure/change without echoing values, exceptions or arbitrary path text. Do not execute configured references or follow provider/retention references. File checks do not prove a trusted host or hostile-parent atomicity beyond tested scope.

Retain append-only evidence; scheduler and retention references are operator inputs, not installed schedule/purge policy. Only site-release schedule is registered now. No schema/database/route/provider binding/runtime settings/host changes in this batch.

Use isolated synthetic CLI controls/source-bound exact commands and independent final source/evidence review plus cheap exact-SHA preflight. No SQL/native tests warranted for pure JSON/filesystem checker. Real sender/provider/approved retention/install/delivery remains dependent on Sean inputs/authorization.
